description:
Self-consistent reference case derived from the AEMO TCD 2.0 workbook's current usrBuildingBlock / usrIndirect inputs for Network Element #1 ('330kV GIS' — the workbook's Data_collection_A sheet carries the label 'Synchronous condenser' from a prior snapshot).

Inputs: 5 building blocks (IDs 13, 681, 645, 652, 1 with quantities 4, 4, 12, 12, 1). No attribute or risk overrides set at the user level; defaults apply: known risks = BAU (all-zero EXCEPT 'Environmental offset risks' which has EO=0.5 even at BAU), unknown risks = Class 5b. Indirect selections: Brownfield band = '$100-$500 million' / stakeholder = 'Commensurate with land use' / delivery model = 'EPC contract'.

Note: the workbook's pre-computed Data_collection_A shows a Total NE Cost of $224,147,626.72 — that snapshot was taken from a different ('Synchronous condenser 2×200MVA'-style) input set which has since been overwritten in usrBuildingBlock without a Refresh. The expected values below are cent-accurate to the engine's computation against the current inputs, which is what the Excel would produce if the user hit Refresh today.
